strings.Статьи 15 и 126 закона № 229-ФЗ дают дес: Articles 15 and 126 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ provide a ten-day period, excluding non-working days, for an authorised official to consider an admissible complaint. This is not a debt-recovery deadline. Suspension of consideration is linked to a court accepting the relevant application, not to the applicant's intention to go to court.
